name: ghostpaw-affinity
description: Local relationship model and social CRM for contacts, relationships, evidence, and commitments.
long_description: Local relationship model and social CRM. Stores data in a local SQLite database.

db_path.title: Database path
db_path.description: Path to the local SQLite database.

tools.name: search_affinity
tools.description: Search contacts by name or identity, including exact natural-key lookups like email-style identifiers.

tools.name: review_affinity
tools.description: Review one affinity surface such as contacts, journals, link queues, commitments, dates, graph state, or merge history.

tools.name: inspect_affinity_item
tools.description: Inspect one exact affinity item such as the owner profile, a contact profile, or one link detail.

tools.name: manage_contact
tools.description: Create a contact, revise one contact's core fields, or change lifecycle state. ALWAYS search_affinity first before creating — duplicates corrupt the graph.

tools.name: merge_contacts
tools.description: Merge one loser contact into one winner contact using explicit contact locators.

tools.name: manage_duplicate_dismissal
tools.description: Dismiss or un-dismiss a duplicate candidate pair so it does not resurface in listDuplicateCandidates.

tools.name: manage_identity
tools.description: Add, revise, verify, or remove one routing identity on a contact. Use this for emails, phone numbers, social handles, and URLs — anything that could locate a person. Do not use manage_attribute for these.

tools.name: manage_relationship
tools.description: Seed social links, revise bond and state, and manage structural ties. Seed a link as soon as a relationship is mentioned — do not wait for repeated evidence.

tools.name: record_event
tools.description: Record one social event such as an interaction, observation, milestone, or transaction. For interactions, milestones, and transactions the owner contact is auto-injected into participants if missing. Observations may omit the owner when recording third-party evidence.

tools.name: manage_commitment
tools.description: Record or resolve one commitment such as a promise or agreement. The owner contact is auto-injected into participants if missing.

tools.name: manage_date_anchor
tools.description: Add, revise, or remove recurring date anchors on contacts or links. Use this for birthdays, anniversaries, and yearly events — not manage_attribute.

tools.name: manage_attribute
tools.description: Set, unset, or replace custom metadata attributes on contacts and links. For emails, phones, handles, and URLs use manage_identity instead — those are routing keys, not attributes.
